Review by bar

      Microphone audio stays in your browser.

      Upload a score

      Choose a MusicXML score or convert a printed score PDF. Practice follows the first MusicXML part, including chords and simultaneous voices.

      PDF conversion runs on the PaperTempo server. Select a PDF with its MusicXML if you already have a conversion.

      How it works

      1. Open a score. Use Morning Lines or upload a melody or chordal MusicXML score.
      2. Hear a passage. Choose the bars, reference tempo, and playback instrument. Select Hear this passage to follow the highlighted notes.
      3. Play it yourself. Keep going follows the reference tempo and grades the passage at the end. Choose Wait for the right note to advance only when you play the expected pitch.
      4. Review your take. Select a mistake to see it on the score and practise those bars again. Finish two takes of the same passage at the same tempo to compare them.
